description: A Python script that checks for disallowed third-party imports in source files, primarily used as a linter adapter within a larger project.

classes.name: LintSeverity
classes.description: Enumeration of severity levels for lint messages.

classes.name: LintMessage
classes.description: Data structure representing a lint message with details about the issue.

methods.name: check_file
methods.description: Checks a given Python file for disallowed third-party imports and returns a list of lint messages.
